source_tiers.label: Original marketplace verified
source_tiers.description: Realized sale stored with direct original marketplace evidence.

source_tiers.label: Secondary-source realized sale
source_tiers.description: A secondary source reports a realized sale on a named marketplace, but the original sale page is not stored.

source_tiers.label: Discovery only
source_tiers.description: Lead or listing evidence without a defensible realized-sale verification.

rules: Asking prices and active listings are excluded from realized-sale market value.
Secondary-source realized sales may support provisional EV but cannot unlock ROI.
Original marketplace verification is tracked at sale and contribution level.
A contribution may be marked original-marketplace verified only when its supporting record contains qualifying original evidence.
Source quality and sample-size quality are separate dimensions.
Market-value freshness is reported separately from source tier.
